Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: autovcoder_025309.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: autovcoder_025309.v · Open raw
module autovcoder_025309 (
    input clk190hz,
    input rst,
    input leftMove,
    input rightMove,
    input inc,
    output [3:0] pos,
    output [7:0] seg,
    output [31:0] myID,
    output [2:0] temp
);

  reg [31:0] msgArray = 0;
  reg [ 2:0] cur = 7;
  reg [15:0] dataBus;
  reg lmv_delay = 0, rmv_delay = 0, inc_delay = 0;

  assign myID = msgArray;
  assign temp = cur;

  always @(posedge clk190hz) begin
    if (!rst) begin
      msgArray = 0;
      cur = 7;
      lmv_delay = 0;
      rmv_delay = 0;
      inc_delay = 0;
    end else begin
      if (leftMove == 1 && lmv_delay == 0) cur = cur + 1;
      else if (rightMove == 1 && rmv_delay == 0) cur = cur - 1;
      else if (inc == 1 && inc_delay == 0) begin
        msgArray = msgArray + (4'b0001 << (4 * cur));
        if (((msgArray >> (4 * cur)) & 4'b1111) == 10) msgArray = msgArray - (4'b1010 << (4 * cur));
      end
      lmv_delay = leftMove;
      rmv_delay = rightMove;
      inc_delay = inc;
    end

    if (cur < 4) dataBus = msgArray[15:0];
    else dataBus = msgArray[31:16];
  end

  segMsg2 u (
      clk190hz,
      rst,
      dataBus,
      cur[1:0],
      pos,
      seg
  );
endmodule
